snippet.title: Necrolord | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
That swordsman who nearly wiped out your army can fight on your side in the next battle. Play as a lich, raise the fallen, and equip your skeletons before they march. When the fighting starts, it’s your turn to cast the spells.

Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5309350/Necrolord_Demo/?utm_source=youtube
Wishlist Necrolord: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5282860/Necrolord/?utm_source=youtube

Thumbnail artwork by Camilo Polanco (Frost Earth Studio).
